name: Crew Berthing · Deck 4 · Section C
frame: Unreal convention: X forward, Y starboard, Z up; metres; origin = deck level on the inner face of the forward wall, on the lift's axis; the compartment runs aft (negative x)
world_note: inside the Aquila's hull amidships, aft of the Mess Hall at its height (x -176..-200, z -46: the hull's inner skin runs at -41.3 m above this part of the ship, so the compartment sits below it like the Mess): the lift joins it to the bridge corridor and the other decks. Eighty-four racks for the ratings of the Red watch; the compartment is kept dim, somebody is always asleep

stacks.note: a stack = three racks one above the other; its head against the outboard wall, its foot on the aisle. Along x: two stacks side by side, then a column of lockers, repeated

lounge.note: the aft end: a table with four stools, the fleet news on the aft wall, a shelf of books and games, a coffee maker

head_door.note: the washroom, forward port corner (a closed door)
